builds.howItPlays: You kill nearly every unit your opponent plays with removal spells like Wages of Pain and Blood Money, and each kill leaves you a Gold token you can cash in like an extra rune to pay for your expensive answers. Viktor, Innovator makes a 1 Might Recruit whenever you play a card on your opponent's turn, and those Recruits, along with the one your Legend makes each turn, score your points once their board is empty.
builds.whyYou: You like keeping problems small before they get big, and you'd rather hold a removal spell until your opponent plays something worth answering. You'll put almost no real units on the board yourself, and you're happy to win with a handful of 1 Might tokens once nothing is left to stop them. Games run long, and every one-for-one trade pulls you a little further ahead. If patience and clean removal sound more satisfying than racing, this Viktor suits you.

builds.howItPlays: You pay 1 energy and exhaust Viktor each turn to make a 1 Might Recruit, then feed those Recruits and cheap units like Honest Broker, which leaves a Gold token to spend like an extra rune when it dies, to Cull the Weak, a spell that makes each player kill one of their own units. Viktor, Leader makes a fresh Recruit whenever one of your other units dies, so your board keeps its numbers while your opponent loses real units, and you score by holding battlefields with what's left.
builds.whyYou: You like trading pieces more than racing. Throwing away a 1 Might token so your opponent has to kill one of their own units feels like a good deal to you, and you enjoy the small calls each turn: spend your energy on a Recruit or keep it for a removal spell, and pick which of your units dies first. You're fine with a game that runs into the middle turns, because every even trade leaves you a little more on the board. If grinding an opponent down with cheap bodies and removal sounds fun, this Viktor suits you.
